# Feature: godot addon confirm

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-15 — issue #44 -->

## Intent
`potato init --godot` previews `addons/potato_boost` and writes it only after `--confirm`. Abort or missing confirm leaves no addon. An existing addon is not overwritten silently.

## Preconditions
- Godot collect/scenario (#43)
- Confirm-only init for potato.config.yaml (#13)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Without confirm, `addons/potato_boost` does not exist
- [ ] Preview lists planned addon files before writing
- [ ] Addon is optional and documents cleanup
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Existing addon is not silently overwritten
- [ ] Init without `--godot` does not copy an addon

## Regression
- [ ] `init` without `--godot` still previews config only
- [ ] Out: Core schema/write path unchanged
- [ ] Out: Asset Library publish

## Assumptions
- Canonical folder is `addons/potato_boost` (PRD)
- UI copy is English
- Dashboard is out of scope

## Security Coverage
- P-04: writes stay under `addons/potato_boost/` inside the project root; `..` rejected
- Confirm required before any addon write
- F-03: no tokens in localStorage
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01

## Implementation Notes
- `potato init --godot` lists `addons/potato_boost/plugin.cfg` and `performance_dump.gd`.
- `--confirm` writes those files only when they do not already exist.
- Init without `--godot` never copies an addon. `packages/core` is unchanged.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: init --godot preview → confirm writes addon once; abort writes nothing.
- N-actors: one project → one addon folder.
- Invalid: existing addon is left unchanged (no silent overwrite).
- Two consumers: CLI init is the only writer; doctor still reports addon as confirm-only.
